annotations.title: Get a shipping address link for your owner

description: Returns a link (valid 60 minutes) where your owner types their shipping address. Use it when a call fails with address_required (the response’s has_address says whether one is already on file). Send it to your owner only; the address is never shown to you. Retry what needed it once they say it’s done. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
name: get_address_link
title: Get a shipping address link for your owner
